Inventory Reorder Monitor

Real-time inventory reorder tracking and capacity monitoring

Usage Guide

Report Purpose

This report monitors inventory levels for parts with configured reorder points, displaying current stock status and recommended order quantities to maintain optimal inventory levels.

Key Metrics

Available: On Hand - Allocated - Not Available + Dropship

Qty to Order: Order Up To - (Available - Committed)

Reorder Point: Minimum threshold triggering reorder alert

Order Up To: Target maximum inventory level

Status Indicators

The Status column uses color-coded cells with gradient fills representing capacity percentage:

-75%
Critical

Below reorder point - fills from right (negative values)

20%
Alert

Within 20% above reorder point - order soon

60%
Good

Adequate stock levels

Overstocked
Overstocked

Above order up to level

How Status % is Calculated

Status % shows where Available falls on the scale:

Critical
Good
Over
0 ROP OUL -100% ← → 0% 0% → 100% >100%

Example: ROP = 50, OUL = 150

-50% Available = 25

0% Available = 50 (at ROP)

50% Available = 100

100% Available = 150 (at OUL)

Over Available > 150

Lead Time

Sourced from the Lead Time field on the default vendor record for each part. Displayed in days — shows — if not configured. Used to determine Days of Stock color thresholds; without a lead time the report falls back to fixed thresholds (30d / 60d).

Days of Stock

Formula: Available ÷ Daily Consumption Rate

Daily rate is derived from outgoing inventory movements (sales shipments and issued picks) over the Consumption Period selected in the header. Hover over any Days of Stock value to see the total units consumed, the period length, and the resulting daily rate.

Normal ≥ 2× lead time (or ≥ 60 days if no lead time)

Watch ≥ lead time but < 2× (or 30–59 days)

Reorder < lead time (or < 30 days)

Shows — when no consumption data exists for the selected period
